topography.project_purpose: KEEP Network is a decentralized protocol that enables cross-chain Bitcoin bridging and staking. It provides infrastructure for minting tBTC, a Bitcoin-backed ERC-20 token, and supports staking mechanisms for network security and rewards.
topography.relationship_narrative: The tBTC L1 contracts serve as the hub for Bitcoin bridging, with L2 families (Arbitrum, Base) and Starknet using Wormhole gateways and depositor/redeemer contracts to extend tBTC minting and redemption cross-chain. The KEEP Network family provides legacy staking and token infrastructure that underpins the security model, while Threshold Contracts represent the governance token layer.
